risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label on the bottom of the laptop or inside the lid, or a system information screenshot.

risks.risk: Specs not matching (e.g., storage/RAM/CPU not as claimed)
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system information (e.g., Windows About page) showing the exact model, RAM, storage, and CPU.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a lower-spec unit, possibly with less RAM or storage, or a different CPU.

risks.risk: Laptop not working or has hardware issues (e.g., screen, battery, ports)

risks.risk: Battery not included or not functional
